summary: Drop the "watch cannot start" label from the dotted route → tick edge, so only one text sits there; the fallback frame title already says it.
rationale: The note is on the dotted route → tick edge, and its label "watch cannot start" is one of the two overlapping texts. That label repeats the fallback frame title, "Fallback lane: the watch cannot start", and that edge runs out of the events route beside two other edges, "1 stamp on connect" and "2 arms the watch". Removing the edge label takes one of the two texts away and loses nothing, because the frame names the condition and the dotted style marks the lane as the fallback. No node moves and no id changes. If the overlap you saw was really between "subscribes" and "6 review event" (two edges between the editor and the route, so their labels share one midpoint), reply on this note and I will propose a fix for that pair instead. No ADR amendment is implied.
